description: This file contains functions for creating audit logs within the LiteLLM Proxy system, including logging creation and updates of objects, with external dependencies on litellm modules, logging, and database interaction.

methods.name: create_object_audit_log
methods.description: Creates an audit log entry for an object operation, including details like object ID, action, user info, and before/after values.

methods.name: create_audit_log_for_update
methods.description: Creates an audit log entry for an object update, writing to the database if audit logging is enabled and the user has premium access.
